title: Dialogue: Food and Drink Idioms (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij ponizsze dialogi (1.1-1.6), wybierajac brakujace wyrazenie A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: Was the maths test difficult?
Y: Not at all, it was a piece of ______.

X: Can you tell me what the book is about in a few words?
Y: In a ______, a boy discovers he can fly.

X: Who told everyone about the surprise party?
Y: Kuba, obviously. He always ______ the beans.

X: He says he swam with sharks last summer.
Y: I'd take that with a ______ of salt.

X: All the best players were chosen for the national squad.
Y: Yes, they took the ______ of the crop.

X: Is it hard to learn to ride a bike?
Y: Not really - it's as easy as ______.
